review.evidence: Candidate release 'LAB FOUNDATION v0.1' equals source_manifest.release. Candidate manifest_sha256 '1e96bf20c4ac476cc4ab92d626d800f0694900aadeb370ed834f3e76332c3535' equals deterministic_checks.checks.actual_manifest_sha256. Candidate entry_count 10 equals manifest files length 10 and checks.manifest_file_count/candidate_entry_count. All 10 candidate entries are a bijection onto manifest files with identical path and sha256 values; candidate is the manifest set sorted lexicographically (AGENTS.md, protocols/HANDOFF.md, protocols/MEMORY.md, protocols/VERIFICATION.md, schemas/evidence.schema.json, schemas/exception.schema.json, schemas/task-packet.schema.json, schemas/verification.schema.json, tools/contracts.py, tools/foundation.py). Derivation code is consistent with these outputs: entries built by sorted() over manifest['files'] projecting path/sha256, manifest_sha256 computed as sha256(raw bytes) of the manifest file, entry_count = len(entries), and the checks() routine compares candidate entries against the sorted manifest projection.
review.verification_method: Static, non-executing review of the supplied machine-assembled evidence only (no live re-audit, no file acquisition, no tools). Performed (a) field-by-field equality comparison of candidate metadata against source_manifest (release, count, manifest hash) and against deterministic_checks.checks; (b) set-level comparison of the 10 candidate {path, sha256} pairs against the 10 manifest {path, sha256} pairs, including a check that the candidate ordering equals sorted(manifest paths) per the declared sort key path; (c) confirmation that deterministic_checks.result == 'PASS' and errors == []; (d) sanity read of derivation_code to confirm the derivation and check procedures are structurally consistent with the observed fields (accepted UTF-8-with-optional-BOM read while hashing raw bytes; sorted projection compared to slices of the manifest).
limitations: Scope is limited to faithful derivation of a navigation index from the already-accepted stored manifest; it does not re-verify that the 10 underlying files' bytes match their recorded SHA-256 values, nor manifest authenticity, provenance, or the acceptance decision itself.
